environment: Chromium, local Expo web export, deterministic API fixtures; no production writes or actual OAuth
results: Fresh install still requires both legal consents; policy links and explicit login/guest choice work.
Region, valid age, illustrated school state and university selection persist; no university hides the campus tab.
Main tabs, detail, notifications and account/legal screens render at 375px; key screens also fit 320px.
Delayed member profile never uses a previous guest draft; home, category and local explore requests use Busan and hide the Yongin fixture.
Editing conditions starts from the saved member profile, saves nickname, clears old city/school metadata and immediately hides the campus tab; simulator also uses the saved profile.
A new member with HTTP 404 Profile not found can save onboarding; logout removes the session and personal condition draft.
